privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.controllerText: {{name}}, reachable at {{email}}. This policy is established in accordance with Moroccan law no. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.
privacy.dataText: Via the quote form: name, phone, e-mail, city, project type, budget, description of the works and, if you wish, an attachment. This information is provided voluntarily by you.
privacy.purposeText: Your data is used only to respond to your request, prepare a quote and contact you about it. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.retentionText: Quote requests are kept for as long as needed to process your project, then deleted no later than 3 years after the last exchange.
privacy.cookiesText: With your consent, we may use audience measurement tools (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) to understand how the site is used. You can accept or refuse, and change your choice at any time.
privacy.rightsText: Under law 09-08, you have the right to access, rectify and object to the processing of your data. To exercise it, write to us at {{email}}. You may also contact the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP).
cookieList: Necessary local storage: it remembers your consent choice (no cookie is set for this).
Audience measurement (Google Analytics): set only if you accept.
Advertising measurement (Meta Pixel): set only if you accept.
Google Maps: loaded only when you click “Show the map”.
privacy.thirdText: To work, the site uses third-party services: EmailJS (sending your quote requests by e-mail), Google Maps (map, after your click) and, with your consent, Google Analytics and Meta Pixel. These providers may process data outside Morocco.
privacy.deleteText: You can ask us to delete your data (quote requests, exchanges) at any time. Write to us at {{email}} stating your name and the e-mail address used: we will process your request as soon as possible and confirm the deletion.

renover-un-appartement-par-ou-commencer.title: Renovating an apartment: where to start?
renover-un-appartement-par-ou-commencer.excerpt: The first decisions to make before starting works, to keep the budget and schedule under control.
paragraphs: Before choosing the colour of the walls, start by defining the goal of your renovation: gaining space, modernising, or bringing the apartment up to standard. This goal guides every choice that follows.
Then carry out a survey: damp, electrics, plumbing, floors. These hidden works weigh the most on the budget, so it is better to know about them before signing a quote.
Ask for an itemised quote with a schedule. This lets you compare, prioritise and, if needed, split the works into several phases.
Finally, allow a margin for the unexpected. In a renovation it is common to discover problems once the walls are opened.

amenager-un-cabinet-medical-points-cles.title: Fitting out a medical practice: the key points
amenager-un-cabinet-medical-points-cles.excerpt: Circulation, acoustics, utilities: what to plan for a practice that is comfortable for patients and efficient for you.
paragraphs: A practice is designed around the patient journey: reception, waiting, consultation. A good layout avoids crossings and protects confidentiality.
Acoustics are often forgotten. Suitable partitions and well-fitted doors stop conversations from carrying into the waiting room.
Plan the utilities ahead: water, electricity, IT, air conditioning. Planning them before the partitions avoids costly rework.
Finally, think about the schedule: a well-planned site lets you open on the planned date.

construire-une-villa-les-etapes.title: Building a villa: the main stages
construire-une-villa-les-etapes.excerpt: From the land study to handing over the keys, the stages to know before getting started.
paragraphs: Everything starts with the land and the plans: soil study, permits and choice of architect. This phase determines the quality and cost of the construction.
Next comes the structural work: foundations, structure, walls and roof. It is the longest stage and the one where site supervision matters most.
The finishing work covers partitions, plumbing, electrics and joinery. Then the final touches: tiling, painting, lighting.
At the end, a handover with a snagging list lets you check every detail before taking possession of the villa.
